responsibility: Handles the local crate’s monomorphization planning: it provides shared monomorphization support such as resolving `CoerceUnsized` metadata, computes which generic parameters are truly needed so irrelevant substitutions can be omitted, collects the full graph of monomorphized mono items required for code generation, and partitions those items into codegen units. Within that pipeline, the partitioning layer coordinates the relevant queries, uses the default strategy to assign items and inlined copies to codegen units with appropriate linkage and visibility, merges units down to the requested count while preserving stable naming for incremental compilation, checks symbol distinctness, and exposes the resulting codegen-unit and codegened-item information.
